title: Ultimate Bans
description: A Ban System with many funktions.
body:
UltimateBans is a large all-in-one moderation and staff plugin for Paper 1.21–1.21.11, designed to make the complete management of players on a server easier, faster, and more organized. The plugin combines classic moderation features such as bans, tempbans, mutes, tempmutes, warns, and unbans with many additional staff tools, allowing moderators and administrators to handle their tasks directly in-game without constantly switching between multiple plugins.

At its core is a flexible punishment system with preconfigured punishment reasons, whose display names and durations can be fully customized via the config.yml. This makes it possible to define exactly which reason should have which duration, such as permanent bans, short timeouts, or multi-day sanctions. Additionally, the plugin stores a history so that previous actions like bans, mutes, kicks, and warnings can be reviewed later. With commands like /check, /history, /warns, /report, /reports, /staffnote, and /staffnotes, staff members can always keep track of ongoing and past moderation cases.

In addition to the punishment system, UltimateBans includes many practical staff and management features. These include freeze and unfreeze to stop players, spectate to discreetly monitor suspicious players, vanish to become invisible, staffchat for internal team communication, invsee and ecsee to view inventories and ender chests, as well as fly, heal, feed, broadcast, tpall, tphere, clearchat, slowchat, nightvision, speed, and several gamemode shortcuts. This makes the plugin suitable not only for punishments but also for daily staff use on community, citybuild, survival, or network servers.

A major advantage of UltimateBans is its high level of customization. Messages, prefixes, displays, reasons, durations, and many server-related texts can be modified directly in the config. This allows the plugin to be easily adapted visually and functionally to match your server’s design. If you are looking for a comprehensive moderation system that combines classic sanctions, staff communication, reports, history, and many useful admin tools into a single plugin, UltimateBans provides a strong foundation for your team.
